adjudication.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts the booking is loaded including `user.credentials` (and `references` with credential info), but the code builds `EventManager` using `getUsersCredentials(ctx.user)` and spreads `...user` from the caller (not `booking.user`). Since this mutation explicitly allows non-organizers (team admin/owner or an attendee) to add guests, the calendar update path `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)` will run under the caller’s credentials rather than the organizer/booking owner’s credentials, making it likely to fail to update the organizer’s calendar event or target the wrong connected account. The unused `booking.user.credentials` include further suggests the intended credentials source was the organizer.
